title: Lab-01 — HTML-first Interactive Game (minimal JS)
milestone: Module 1 — Multipage HTML + CSS + inline JS
task: Complete the Lab 1 document. Build an HTML-first, multi-page interactive game. Inline JS used for small interactions.
acceptance: Upload final files to labs/lab-01/ with entrypoint index.html
Add a link in the root index.html to labs/lab-01/index.html
Verify the published link loads using GitHub Pages
Add a README.md file to labs/lab-01/ with your reflections on HTML

title: Lab-03 — Bootstrap: Responsive Portfolio
milestone: Module 1 — Multipage HTML + CSS + inline JS
task: Build a responsive personal portfolio using Bootstrap 5 (grid, cards, carousel, navbar). Include pages: landing, projects, blog, about, contact.
acceptance: Place source in labs/lab-03/ with entrypoint index.html and supporting pages (projects.html, blog.html, about.html, contact.html)
Add a link in the root index.html to labs/lab-03/ (live GitHub Pages)
Use Bootstrap 5: navbar + grid rows/columns; include at least 1 card group and 1 carousel
Add labs/lab-03/README.md with with your reflections on Bootstrap

title: Project-01 — Interactive Game in HTML & CSS
milestone: Module 1 — Multipage HTML + CSS + inline JS
task: Read and complete the Project-01 document from the instructor’s repo. Design your own deployable multi-page interactive game. JS is allowed, but no frameworks or build tools.
acceptance: Create projects/project-01/README.md with links to your project repo and deployed app
Add a link in the root index.html to your deployed Project-01
Include a feature checklist and one screenshot in the project README
Include your design documents and flowchart in a projects/project-01/docs/ folder

title: Capstone-01 — Find a Team
task: Form a team. Create your team repo and Project (v2) board, and add initial goals.
acceptance: Create capstone/capstone-01/README.md with team roster and one-paragraph idea summary
Create a Project board and include its URL in the README
Ensure the board is public or shared with instructors
